The drawer primitive shadcn/ui's own Drawer is built on — snap points, nested drawers and scroll locking.

Source: [vaul](https://github.com/emilkowalski/vaul) by emilkowalski — MIT.

shadcn/ui's Drawer already wraps this; install it directly only when you need the primitive.

```bash
npm install vaul
```
